notes.title: Big Reveal Announcement
notes.content:
Heyho everyone,

What? Daedalic is back to the roots? Well, yes - at least when it comes to releasing Point&Click Adventures! 

We proudly present Three Headed Monkey Studios’ debut masterpiece: [b]Ghost Haunting[/b]!

[previewyoutube=x5SLX8j11yM;full][/previewyoutube]

Flabbergasted? Excited? We feel you - that's why you can check out a first sneak peak of the ("pre-alpha") gameplay with german Streamer Gronkh on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/gronkh]his Twitch channel[/url], Friday 11th of July at 6pm cest.

And obviously - don't forget to wishlist to stay up to date with all the exiciting news in the future!


Daedalic Entertainment & 
Three Headed Monkey Studio
